title: Google Ads Performance & Health Audit Report

sections.executiveSummary: High-level diagnostic of Google Ads account health, spend pacing, and ROAS floor compliance.
sections.overallScore: Deterministic health score (0-100) combining ROAS, CPA drift, search impression share, and Quality Score.
sections.findings: Categorized audit findings across Performance Max asset groups, Search match types, and Shopping feeds.
sections.issues: Identified spend bleeders, low Quality Score keywords (<5/10), and negative keyword conflicts.
sections.recommendations: Ranked optimization proposals including bid adjustments and negative keyword additions.
sections.priorityMatrix: Impact vs Effort 4-quadrant prioritization matrix (P0 Critical to P3 Housekeeping).
sections.actionPlan: Numbered step-by-step implementation roadmap with expected impact metrics.
sections.supportingEvidence: Aggregated Google Ads GAQL metric snapshots and impression share statistics.
sections.appendix: Technical definitions, conversion action configuration status, and attribution models.
